dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Nam from next door. I don't think we've met. Do you have a minute?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ˈnɑːm frəm ˈnɛkst ˈdɔːr. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk wiːv ˈmɛt. duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈmɪnɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, I was hoping that we could talk about the music at night. I start a new job next week, and I need to sleep early.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪ wʌz ˈhoʊpɪŋ ðæt wiː kʊd ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmjuːzɪk ət ˈnaɪt. aɪ ˈstɑːrt ə ˈnuː ˈdʒɑːb ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk, ənd aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈsliːp ˈɜːrli.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry. I practice my guitar in the evenings. I play in a band.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈsɑːri. aɪ ˈpræktɪs maɪ ɡɪˈtɑːr ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋz. aɪ ˈpleɪ ɪn ə ˈbænd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I understand. It's your hobby. Perhaps you could stop at ten?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ɪts jʊr ˈhɑːbi. pərˈhæps juː kʊd ˈstɑːp ət ˈtɛn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ten is a bit early for me. I don't get home from work until eight.
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛn ɪz ə ˈbɪt ˈɜːrli fər miː. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɛt ˈhoʊm frəm ˈwɜːrk ənˈtɪl ˈeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Then it might be better to practice from eight to ten thirty?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈðɛn ɪt maɪt bi ˈbɛtər tə ˈpræktɪs frəm ˈeɪt tə ˈtɛn ˈθɜːrti?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That works for me. And in return, could you tell me if it's ever too noisy?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈwɜːrks fər miː. ənd ɪn rɪˈtɜːrn, kʊd juː ˈtɛl miː ɪf ɪts ˈɛvər ˈtuː ˈnɔɪzi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. That's a good suggestion. It's fair to both sides.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ðæts ə ˈɡʊd səɡˈdʒɛstʃən. ɪts ˈfɛr tə ˈboʊθ ˈsaɪdz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great, a win-win! Perhaps we could have coffee sometime, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt, ə ˌwɪn ˈwɪn! pərˈhæps wiː kʊd ˈhæv ˈkɔːfi ˈsʌmtaɪm, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like that. Thanks for being so understanding.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk ˈðæt. ˈθæŋks fər ˈbiːɪŋ soʊ ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No problem. Good luck with your new job!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. ˈɡʊd ˈlʌk wɪð jʊr ˈnuː ˈdʒɑːb!
